Course description

One pretest across the C and C++ sequence (CP101 through CP204). For each course it has three kinds of question: predict the output (or spot the undefined behavior), find the bug, and write a short function. Any course you pass is marked complete, and the rest teach only the sections you missed.

Learning objectives

  1. Show what you already know of C, the machine level, core C++, modern C++, the standard library and concurrency.
